description: Change a sandbox's metadata, egress network rules, auto-delete window, or auto-pause timeouts after creation. Use this to lock down or open up outbound network access (rules apply to new connections), or to schedule cleanup of a sandbox you no longer need running. Only the fields you pass are changed.

allow_out.description: Egress allow rules — domain patterns, IPs, or CIDRs to permit. For a strict allowlist, always also pass deny_out: ['0.0.0.0/0']. allow_out alone can also block destinations that are not listed, so list every host the workload needs; if it has domain rules or the workload resolves hostnames, include the sandbox DNS resolvers '1.1.1.1/32' and '8.8.8.8/32'.

auto_delete_seconds.description: Delete the sandbox once continuously paused for this many seconds (max 2592000 = 30 days); the countdown starts now if it is already paused. Pass null to disable auto-delete. Omit to leave unchanged.

deny_out.description: Egress deny rules — IPs or CIDRs, no domains (a bare IP is stored as its /32; '0.0.0.0/0' denies all egress). Combine with allow_out to lock down egress; deny-all also blocks DNS, so allow_out needs '1.1.1.1/32' and '8.8.8.8/32' whenever names must resolve.

idle_timeout_seconds.description: Auto-pause the sandbox after this long with no activity (60 to 604800 seconds). Pass null to turn idle pausing off. Omit to leave unchanged.

preview_access.description: Change the default access for newly published ports. Existing ports keep their own mode.

sandbox_id.description: ID of the sandbox to update.

timeout_seconds.description: Auto-pause the sandbox once it has been active this long, used or not (max 604800 = 7 days). Pass null to disable. Omit to leave unchanged.

name: sandbox_update
title: Update a sandbox
